name: read_file_large
description: read_file must handle byte offsets past 64 KiB. src/agent/loop.zig is over 100 KB; the string 'parallel_tool_stack_bytes' appears well past the 64 KiB mark. The agent must use read_file with an offset to find it.
prompt: Using the read_file tool, read src/agent/loop.zig starting at byte offset 70000 with a limit of 20000 bytes. Does the returned text contain the string 'parallel_tool_stack_bytes'? Answer with only YES or NO.
